contexts.text: The antediluvian women wore a hat turreted in front. SE 3589, Explained.
Let us build us a city and a tower () = that they invented a doctrine and a worship.
A tower = the worship of self. Explained.

The reason the love of self in worship, or the worship of self, is called a tower, is that a city = doctrine... and the cities in old times were fortified with towers in which were guards. Moreover there were towers at the boundaries; and they were therefore called guard-towers, and watch-towers. Illustrated.
They who build Babylonish towers...
Watch-towers = phantasies.
As mountains and towers = the love of self and of the world... the Lord was led by the devil upon a high mountain and a pinnacle of the temple.
Beyond the tower of Eder () = into the interiors of it. Explained.
That towers = interior things. Illustrated.
Towers, in the Word, are predicated of truths; and mountains, of goods.
The so-called saints, in Jupiter, wear a turreted hat of a dark colour. SE 588.
The beginning of Babylonish dominion is described by the city and the tower whose head was in heaven.
The Babylonians have watch-towers built in the midst of their congregation, from which they can extend their sight into all the neighbouring parts.
Some were seen who were building a tower which reached up into Heaven where the Angels are; but this was only a representative of their machinations.
Like one who stands on a lofty tower. SE 4393. SE 4506.
Such an onslaught of the Hells is meant by the tower built in the land of Shinar... TCR 276.
(Quakerism) represented by a high, pointed, tower, of a grey colour...
See Last Judgment, SE 4966. SE 4979.
For a tower = doctrine.
An immense tower seen.

Towers () = doctrines of falsity. ( = those who are in evils and the derivati ve falsities; in special, those who are in the love of dominating by means of the holy things of the Church. AE 401:10.) ( = the falsities of doctrine which are from the love of self and of the world... for, in the Spiritual World, those who seek to rule by the things of the Church, build towers for themselves in high places. AE 405:6.)
Tower, and wall () = confirmed falsities of doctrine. AE 514:9.
To number her towers () = to consider the higher or interior truths of that Church.
Towers () = interior truths.
From the tower of Seventh to the border of Cush () = from primes to ultimates.
He built a tower in the midst of it () = the interior things into which there is influx, and through which there is communication with Heaven.
And built a tower () = The interior truths from that good, which looked to Heaven.
